logline: While Alexander reassures Juliana of their unbreakable bond amid the council's opposition, a destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne—only for Juliana to offer her survival under the strict humiliation of a scullery maid.

candidates.hook_text: Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry.
candidates.cliffhanger_text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.
candidates.rationale: High-impact opening confrontation immediately establishes the emotional stakes with no prior context required.
